metadata.description: Stick-figure (asterism) stars of the 88 IAU constellations with position and distance, for qualitative 3D display.

sources.name: HYG Database v4.1 (Hipparcos, Yale Bright Star, Gliese)

fields.ra_hours: right ascension, hours, J2000 epoch and equinox
fields.dist_ly: distance in light-years from parallax; null when no usable parallax
fields.dist_uncertain: present when the distance is 1000 pc or more, or unknown
fields.segments: stick-figure lines as index pairs into this constellation's stars array
fields.pieces: present when the figure has separate parts; stars are ordered piece by piece, largest first

metadata.ordering: stars run from one end of the figure to the other; side branches are listed where they leave the main line
